reviews.text: Very kind and precise beautician. Flexible and patient even with my not-so-problematic (hysterical) husky🐺☺️ I highly recommend him!

Taro's favorite dog groomer, he has been going to Kati's for over a year, he arrives cheerfully and proudly comes home with his fur trimmed. As a regular Shiba, Taro is not an easy case, but he behaves exemplary here. Thank you!

We can only recommend him! Finally, a professional who doesn't just want to "put dogs down", but really pays attention to them and cares about them. He listened to all our requests and handled the whole situation with incredible patience and professionalism, as our dog is unfortunately very sensitive to clipping. It was a great feeling to see that the dog's comfort and safety are truly important to him. We are maximally satisfied, we will definitely come back! 😊
Elzus loves it🫶🏻 Thank you for your kindness and the cool haircut!! …
The beautician is a true dog lover, a very good professional! I recommend him to everyone!
Our timid greyhound is always in safe hands with Kati, we love going to her! I recommend her with a warm heart 😊 …
Super cute, perfect! Thank you

My dog ​​usually approaches every new situation with reservations. But with Kati, he always calms down quickly, so I am very happy to entrust him with her.
I always get her back nicely and well-groomed, and it is clear that the time spent there was not a stressful experience for her.
It feels good to entrust your dog to someone who shows that they are not only doing their job, but also really love what they do.
Kati cut Szotyi's fur very nicely and meticulously. Plus, Szotyi felt completely safe the whole time, which I was especially happy about 😊😊 I can only recommend it!! …

We found Kati years ago when I adopted my dog. She is the kindest, most thorough groomer we have ever been to, and ever since then I only take my dog ​​to her when I can. There was no question that we would follow her to Óbunda! Kuglóf always leaves Kati's hands very happy, and last but not least, beautiful. Kati treats dogs patiently and gently, I always entrust my dog ​​to her with peace of mind. I only recommend her to everyone!
Kati, the owner is the best, strongly recommended; does a thorough Goob, very good with dogs and a super nice person to be around in general.
I recommend her wholeheartedly to everyone, she is very kind, patient, and does a beautiful job. I left the dogs there with a calm heart while they were groomed.
Wow... our dog feels wonderful here.

I am extremely satisfied!! Sófi's fur became very beautiful after the grooming, she still smelled very good days later and she was combed out very thoroughly, since then she has hardly shed any hair, even though spring shedding is usually very rough for her. My dog ​​was in very good hands and I left her at the grooming with a completely calm heart from the first minute.🤍
Kind, fast, skilled. He works with fair prices. It's worth stopping by if you have a dog.

As a professional, I wouldn't trust my dog ​​to just anyone. I often don't have time to do it myself and I don't want to anymore, because Kati does a beautiful job every time. ❤️
She is kind, patient and I leave Panka with her with a calm heart, because I know she is in the best hands. 🩷
I highly recommend her to everyone! Kati is very kind, reliable and always makes Drazse look beautiful, if she is happy to come to her! :)

Kata has been grooming my little spitz, Lola, for over three years, and it's no coincidence that she's admired every day on the street. She always does a beautiful, meticulous job, and Lola looks simply great after every session.

What's especially important to me is that Kata is very kind and patient with dogs. Lola really loves going to her, which I think says everything about the atmosphere she creates.

She's also extremely reliable: she's always punctual, everything happens at the agreed time, and if she finishes early, she's always nice.

We simply love her and wouldn't even think of taking Lola to any other dog groomer. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone who wants their dog to be in the best hands. 🐾✨
Lora doesn't get hysterical here and always gets a wonderful cavi kozmi 🩷 …
After the first time, I brought my puppy with a very good feeling. The place is cute, Kati is also very nice and skilled :-) I recommend it to everyone.
We've been to his place twice, I've only had positive experiences, precise, kind, perfect work🥰 you can take your dog here with peace of mind because they treat him super well🐾 …

Finally, a salon where Yara doesn't come out stressed and overworked, but cheerful and beautiful, trimmed according to breed standards, and her fur is perfectly cared for! 🐶✨
Kati is incredibly patient and kind, it shows how much she loves animals and what she does.
Yara first came to her as a puppy, after previous negative experiences at other salons I was a little worried. However, when I saw how lovingly and calmly she treats her, I was completely reassured. I've been bringing her here ever since, because I know she's in good hands – and by the way, Yara loves Kati incredibly (and so do we😌🤍)!!

We would like to thank Kati for her wonderful work! She also did our little maltipoo's first grooming, and it was such a positive experience for him that since then whenever he sees a dryer or a comb, he immediately runs because he thinks it's time for a game. 😊
Today we went to her again after a six-month absence, my dog's fur was in a pretty tangled state, but Kati did a real miracle with him again. We are extremely satisfied, my little dog loves being with her, and I leave her there with complete peace of mind.
I recommend her wholeheartedly to everyone! 🐾
Kati is very nice, she trimmed my griffon beautifully. The place also has a very good vibe. I recommend it to everyone with all my heart!
Kind, patient, thorough.
Kati was very kind and friendly! I didn't worry for a minute that I entrusted our dog to her, who turned out to be a cute little ball! ❤️

It was my first time visiting them, and the end result exceeded all my expectations — my dog ​​turned out beautiful and looked like he was having a great time. They were very kind, patient, and attentive to him.

We have taken Simi to Kati's several times, the best dog groomer in Óbuda! She always listens to what we want, works with the utmost precision, and loves dogs. Thank you very much for the little Christmas gift, it was incredibly cute!
Nudlika will be very beautiful after every occasion :)
Kati is a very kind, thorough professional, and the salon is always super cozy! :)
Fibi is shy by the way, but she immediately accepted Kati and I got this friendly place back, beautifully and beautifully decorated🥰Thank you!! …

Kind, skilled beautician.
I recommend!

Kati is very skilled and incredibly kind and cute with the dogs. The place is also super cozy, modern and tastefully decorated, it feels good to enter right away. I can only recommend it to everyone who wants their dog to receive professional, yet loving care!
✨
Kati is very kind and a good professional, I would never trust my little poodle to anyone else! 🎉 …
Kind, clever, we love you very much. 🤩 …

Finding a new dog groomer is always a matter of trust – especially for a 15-year-old dog. 🐩 When we met Kati, we immediately felt at ease. She is kind, attentive, and treats Molly with such love, as if she had always known her. It is clear that she not only knows her stuff, but also truly loves what she does. Molly always awaits us happy and beautifully groomed. We are so glad we found you – you are a real treasure! 😍
Kati is the best :) Hector and I only go to her🐶 …
Kati always makes sure the fit is exactly as I imagined. My puppy can see that he feels safe with her. I recommend it to everyone!
Kati is the most thorough and conscientious dog groomer we have ever had. The atmosphere is very good, I wasn't afraid to leave Sesame with her and I got him back beautifully. Thank you very much!

With our dogs Pamacs and Zizi, we had been looking for a beautician who was caring and skilled for a long time, and that's when we found Kati, whom we and the dogs loved immediately! From the first moment, the girls felt that Kati was a true friend, whom we could go to whenever we needed. She always spoke to my dogs in a friendly and kind way, and I knew then that they were in the best hands here. When Kati said that "they are my best friends" I already felt that I was bringing them to the right place. We have been coming to you for years, at first you only worked a 10-minute walk, later you even had to travel half an hour, but we still stick with your work and kindness! And the little bow on my dogs' necks is just the icing on the cake! Thank you Kati! ❤️ Postscript: Kati, we are very proud of you and happy that you managed to open your own salon! ❤️
